title: Should You Buy Palantir Stock Before the Huge Investor Update? | PLTR Stock Analysis
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc previews Palantir's 2 Nov earnings from near all-time highs and downgrades his conviction: the buy ranking stays, but conviction falls from medium to low, and his action advice is to neither buy nor sell before the print — wait for the numbers. The business is booming on fundamentals, not just momentum: revenue accelerated 93% to $1.9B, US commercial revenue grew 149%, total contract value rose 49%, remaining US commercial deal value rose 124%, operating margin hit 47% with $912M of operating income, operating cash flow reached $1.2B, and the balance sheet holds over $9.2B of cash with no debt. But at 85x forward earnings — near the most expensive of 2026, with 100x+ his 'too expensive' line from 2025 — and his fair value at $192 versus a $199 market price, the stock is fairly valued with more downside than upside into earnings. He bought near $106 earlier in the year and upgraded to a buy then; the stock is up over 12% year to date in 2026, roughly matching the S&P 500. No other tickers discussed in substance. Calls made: PLTR — HOLD (stance flip: was BUY 8 Oct, now HOLD, with conviction cut to low); he will not add or trim before the update.
